annotations.title: Monitor Shopify Competitor Price & Restock Deltas

description:
Monitor up to 50 external Shopify competitor stores (up to 2,500 products each) for price, stock, catalog, and MAP changes against persisted Key-Value Store snapshots.

Parameters: Requires storeUrls (omitting it returns 0 items at $0). minPriceChangePercent and mapThresholds trigger CRITICAL alerts, emitBaselineSummary controls first-run output, and stateStoreName isolates snapshots per workflow (avoid concurrent runs on the same stateStoreName). Requires APIFY_TOKEN.

Behavior & Billing: Writes persistent KV snapshots and optional webhookUrl alerts, isolates per-store or webhook errors in OUTPUT_SUMMARY without aborting, and bills $2/1K real deltas ($0 on baseline or unchanged runs).

Use for recurring Shopify SKU monitoring; do not use for editing your Shopify admin, Meta ad audits (use audit_meta_ads_advertisers), or retail stockists (use extract_brand_store_stockists).

emitBaselineSummary.description: Emit 1 zero-cost baseline_initialized summary on the first snapshot of each store.

eventTypes.description: Optional subset of catalog or pricing event types to emit.

mapThresholds.description: Optional map of SKU or product handle to Minimum Advertised Price (flags mapViolation: true and severity: CRITICAL if below threshold).

maxProductsPerStore.description: Maximum products to fetch per store URL (50-2,500, paginated at 250/page).

minPriceChangePercent.description: Minimum percentage change threshold (0-100) before emitting price_drop or price_increase.

stateStoreName.description: Named Apify Key-Value Store (alphanumeric and hyphens only) used to persist snapshots between runs.

storeUrls.description: List of 1 to 50 external Shopify store or collection URLs, e.g. ["https://www.allbirds.com"].

webhookUrl.description: Optional Slack, Discord, or n8n webhook URL notified when at least 1 delta occurs.

name: monitor_shopify_competitor_deltas

actor.description: Apify Actor slug that produced these records.

count.description: Total number of records returned in items.

items.description: Detected Shopify competitor pricing, inventory, or catalog delta events.

mapViolation.description: True if price fell below configured MAP threshold.

severity.description: Action priority tier: CRITICAL, INVENTORY, or CATALOG.
